notes.title: Patch 0.2.3
notes.content:
[p]In patch 0.2.3 the following changes were made:[/p][list][*][p]Enemies now grow stronger with each wave than before (including the boss);[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect display of enemy health for each player;[/p][/*][*][p]The maximum number of enemies per session is capped at 100; no new enemies will spawn beyond this limit;[/p][/*][*][p]The shop system has been completely reworked: once an item reaches its maximum level, a Story Shard will appear in the shop’s inventory;[/p][/*][*][p]Level map optimized: removed unnecessary obstacles as well as the bridge over the swamp;[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the logic of “Count Dracula’s Cloak” and adjusted several parameters of other items.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Final touches in Patch 0.2.2!
Here comes HOTFIX 0.2.1.
notes.content:
[h3]The following issues have been fixed:[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Fixed an issue where death during a session was impossible.  
[*] Fixed incorrect display of ability UI at the start of a session.  
[*] Added energy refill orbs on "Grim Tales" difficulty.  
[*] Adjusted Alice's energy regeneration on "Grim Tales" difficulty.  
[*] Updated enemy movement paths.  
[*] Tweaked enemy shader — now enemies stand out more clearly against the environment.  
[*] Rebalanced character abilities.  
[*] Fixed missing attack, death, and damage sounds for enemies.  
[*] Chests no longer appear between waves; if a chest is not collected before the wave ends, it disappears.  
[*] Notifications now display correctly.  
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.2 — Major Changes and News
notes.content:
[h2]General Updates:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Graphics renderer switched to URP.  
[*] Added difficulty selection: Easy and Hard.  
[*] Reworked Inverse Kinematics (IK) system for characters.  
[*] Added Zoom-In and Zoom-Out camera functionality.  
[*] Fixed issue with changing language during a session.  
[*] Adjusted UI layout in main menu and in-level:  
[list]  
[*] Redrew main heroines' avatars.  
[*] Updated the lobby background.  
[*] Added new settings to the menu.  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[h2]Map Changes:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Added ability to collect berries to restore health.  
[*] New buildings and vegetation added.  
[*] Introduced NPC (currently in test mode).  
[*] Time of day changed within the level.  
[/list]  
[h2]Character Ability Updates:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Red Riding Hood:  
[list]  
[*] "Shooting Madness": each projectile now hits only one target.  
[*] "Favorite Trap": can now stun enemies (excluding bosses).  
[/list]  
[*] Alice:  
[list]  
[*] "Toxic Tea": deals damage over time in the affected area.  
[*] "Sharpshooter": arrows pierce through enemies.  
[/list]  
[/list]  
[h2]Shop Overhaul:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Items split into "Consumables" and "Artifacts" tabs.  
[*] Added inventory refresh function.  
[*] Enforced requirement to purchase consumables.  
[*] Shop UI completely redesigned.  
[*] Artifact limit: up to 6 types, each with up to 12 pieces.  
[*] Full artifact set grants access to Story Shards (enhance stats).  
[/list]  
[h2]Level-Up System:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] XP bar removed.  
[*] New levels granted automatically after each wave.  
[*] Some Story Shards have been reworked.  
[/list]  
[h2]Network Fixes:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Improved exiting from sessions and lobby.  
[*] Fixed player death logic (if both host and client die — session ends).  
[*] Refined teammate rescue mechanic (Right Mouse Button).  
[*] Enemies now switch targets correctly.  
[*] Character now displays properly in lobby after switching.  
[*] Many other minor network improvements.  
[/list]  
[h2]In Development:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Story campaign is in active development, which caused update delays.  
[*] Story inspired by the vibe of classics like Madagascar, Shrek 2, etc.  
[*] First chapter of the campaign is coming very soon.  
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.6
notes.content:
We are excited to introduce Patch 0.1.6, which brings numerous improvements and new features to the game.

Key Changes:
Shop System Rework:
- You can now purchase the same artifact multiple times, with their effects stacking to further enhance your character’s power.
Artifact Indicators:
- Added new visual effects to make active artifacts easier to track.

Balance and Gameplay Adjustments:
Updated Formulas:
The following mechanics have been reworked for better balance:
- Lifesteal.
- Attack speed.
- Health regeneration.
- Energy regeneration.

Enemy Scaling:
- The logic behind enemy strength progression across waves has been reworked, offering a more balanced and challenging experience.

Boss and Enemy Adjustments:
- Damage, experience, and health parameters for bosses and enemies have been adjusted to ensure fairer combat.

New Features:
Halloween Character Skins:
- Celebrate the Halloween spirit with thematic character skins.
Meta Progression:
- A new progression system has been introduced, allowing players to accumulate resources between sessions. In the future, these resources can be spent in the shop for permanent upgrades.

Improvements:
Character Abilities:
- Abilities have been enhanced to make each character more unique and impactful.

Economy:
- The in-session economy has been rebalanced, including adjustments to costs and rewards.
- The drop rates for Beans and Multicoins have been fine-tuned, making rewards feel fairer and more consistent.

Thank you for your support and feedback! This update marks another step toward creating a more engaging and immersive experience. Share your thoughts and ideas—together, we can make the game even better!

notes.title: The boss has arrived!
notes.content:
In this new minor update, we introduce the map boss, who appears several waves after the game begins.

[h1]Additionally:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Music changes,
[*] Improved settings and localization,
[*] UI fixes,
[*] Ability adjustments.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3
notes.content:
The update is slightly delayed, but not without reason. In patch 0.1.3, improvements are focused more on UI and GUI elements rather than gameplay features.

[list]
[*] Added Russian and Chinese languages,
[*] Added settings option,
[*] Updated UI wave number alerts, and added sound effects for selecting specific menus,
[*] Fixed some issues in the level and main menu.
[/list]

A surprise awaits you in the next patch 🐻

notes.title: Game Update — Patch 0.1.2
notes.content:
We are pleased to introduce a new update that brings numerous improvements, new features, and fixes to the game. Thank you for your support and feedback, which help us make the game better!

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new hero — Alice: You can now select a new character in the lobby.
[*] Added in-game chat: Communicate with other players directly in the game.
[*] Added shooting objects: Hitting them grants you beans, and with a rare chance, multicoins.
[*] Added visual shooting effect: Shooting has become even more exciting.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Enhanced character animations and IK: Character movements are now smoother and more realistic.
[*] Changed the spawn positions of beans, multicoins, and buffs: They are now distributed more evenly.
[*] Modified the logic of some attributes: Game balance has been improved for a more engaging gameplay experience.
[*] Changed the item update principle on levels: Updated items will help you in fighting enemies.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed crashes in the main menu: You can now restart the game without any issues.
[*] Fixed location issues: Adjusted positions of items, chests, and the shop.
[*] Fixed the bug where multiple buffs and items appeared in the same place: This will improve game balance and fairness.
[*] Fixed inability to purchase certain items in the shop: All items are now available for purchase.
[*] Fixed the logic of gaining levels: Levels now accumulate, and after a wave, you can gain more than one level.
[*] Fixed the bug with automatic leveling up to level 5: Now, level progression corresponds to the experience gained.
[/list]

Thank you for playing our game! We continue to work on new updates and value your opinion. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please share them with us.

We wish you an enjoyable game!

notes.title: Week One Patch
notes.content:
For certain reasons, our day-one patch turned into a week-one patch 👉👈

But it’s finally out! We've fixed most of the bugs and crashes. Now, the co-op mode works stably, and in-game elements like beans and coins are correctly added to the inventory. You can find the rest of the changes below:

[b]Patch 0.1.1[/b]
[list]
[*] Disabled shooting when clicking in the purchase and level-up windows
[*] Adjusted the enemy wave system: monsters will no longer spawn if their number in the wave exceeds the designated limit
[*] Synchronized notifications between clients
[*] Corrected the display of enemy and wave counters
[*] Added revival of allies when their health runs out
[*] Updated the lobby list
[*] Fixed an issue with purchasing items priced under 100 beans
[*] Fixed an issue with being unable to pick up multicoins
[*] Fixed the issue with the wave timer appearing
[*] Corrected the incorrect display of attributes
[*] Fixed a bug with the store, where a specific artifact can be purchased only once now
[*] Fixed chest spawns and item drops from them
[*] Fixed inaccuracies in the display of UI elements
[*] Improved optimization
[/list]
Thank you again for your patience. We will continue to delight you with new patches and events.

P.S. The first such event is just around the corner 🎃
